exposure: Parity (number of pregnancies carried beyond 20 weeks)
outcome: Infant gut microbiome composition (alpha diversity, beta diversity)
cohort: The study assessed 746 infants whose mothers were stratified by parity (1 to 7+ pregnancies carried beyond 20 weeks).
finding: Parity significantly affected early infant gut microbiome composition through the first year of life.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was a significant contributor to infant microbiome composition at 2 months, and in Cesarean-delivered infants, early life parity-related differences were absent.
